versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Fountain Pen Ink Alchemist.
- Provides dilution math for mixing, shading, and adjusting fountain pen inks.
- Calculates dry-time estimates factoring in glycerin content and humidity.
- Logs custom batches (ratios, components, notes) to an ink_log.json file for reproducibility.
- Includes recipe comparison tables for dry time, flow, wash resistance, and nib safety.
- Converts drops↔ml and estimates converter fills/pages by nib width.
- Explains safe ink types for fountain pens and critical safety/rust/clogging rules.
